thread.title: Review continuation part 5
thread.preview:
**Decennium Descent is VIDEO-GAME-ONLY.** My opening recap incorrectly carried forward the retired tabletop requirement. Player readability remains important, but tabletop procedures, physical dice, and manual Game Master bookkeeping are not active design requirements. The engine may track exact timing, hidden state, geometry, provenance, and concurrent clocks. Tabletop-origin material remains historical evidence only; new consequential completion rules still require explicit scoped authorship and joint review.

### Two distinct Part 5 chats

This is **Review continuation part 5**, separate from **Calibration Review Part 5** (`6ad4a867-f330-83e9-829e-bf2bb41a6c09`).

The completed **Illusion / Perception14 Current12** return belongs to that other chat, under assistant response `1329ce3a-137c-4789-928c-b0eda39df21e`. **Companion / Life10 Exact05**, submitted there under `e7643d79-8ef1-4c64-b216-89a20101d269`, has **no final verdict yet**. Its review remains there; Codex will transfer the actual result. The disposition string in my opening recap must not be treated as an issued verdict or predetermined acceptance.

### Recorded checkpoint

The following is recorded **from your reconciliation, not independently verified here**:

| Area | Recorded state |
|---|---|
| Membership | **525 reviewed / 323 pending**, totaling **848 identities**; **249 standalone ordinary spell procedures**; **173 accepted scoped interfaces** |
| Illusion | Current12 repair replay, comparison, and reversal preserved with **339 checks**. Current13’s eight-artifact rendering has **309 packaging checks**, but its exact rendering verdict and membership adoption remain outstanding. |
| Queue27 / checkpoint34 | **181 pending identities in 27 prepared or active groups**, plus **142 ungrouped**. The four-spell source conference and Rank8 Ward5 remain queued and unadopted. |
| Backup boundary | Reported verified GitHub backup through **checkpoint32**, at `c9c9ffb759f3c48ce47a814f03c4e53b2cfeb2a0`. Later Illusion work, review receipts, and checkpoints33–34 remain locally preserved. |
| Allowance | **35% remaining** is the latest reported observation; **20% remaining** is the owner’s latest stop threshold. |

**IN6-09-A and IN6-09-B remain whole-case holds. No current exact-CR2 Undead is cleared.** Steed suppression and Spectral Army’s hidden-target handling remain source-specific. True Seeing retains its accepted union of both printed placements without expanding actual class/school access. Creation, Control15, Mental Prison, and the historical mid-resolution Mind Maze premise retain their separate or conditional holds.

Runtime implementation/testing, human gameplay, numerical balance, cosmology canon, 75-domain closure, whole-game completion, and release remain separate gates.

**This acknowledgment changes no review membership, issues no Companion verdict, starts no duplicate review, and approves no unattached packet.** Exact13’s supplied metadata does not establish access to or acceptance of its bytes.
